name: Station
author: myockey
description: Station readiness for digital-mode operators: time sync, CAT control and radio audio at a glance, with a green/amber/red bar indicator.

barWidget.description: Green/amber/red station readiness: time sync, CAT and radio audio.

schema.label: Readiness refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the time source and CAT link are probed. Radio audio updates live.

schema.label: GPS mode
schema.description: Off: no GPS, NTP is enough. Optional: GPS is configured, so losing it warns but a fix without PPS or an unselected fix stays green. Required: losing it, a fix without PPS or an unselected fix all warn.
